description: Canonical claim and conflict ledger for consolidating the retained framework documents.

status_vocabulary.established: The statement follows from standard definitions or cited theorem-level evidence.
status_vocabulary.corrected: The source claim contains a repairable mathematical or terminological error; the canonical statement records the repair.
status_vocabulary.bounded: A narrower statement is supported within explicit assumptions or data limits.
status_vocabulary.conjectural: The statement is precise enough to test but has not passed its stated falsification gate.
status_vocabulary.unsupported: The statement lacks a defined mechanism, derivation, or discriminating evidence.
status_vocabulary.falsified: A stated or implemented version fails a reproducible counterexample or measurement.
status_vocabulary.repaired: A reproducible implementation defect was corrected and regression-tested.
status_vocabulary.excluded: The statement is too undefined or non-empirical to enter the scientific core.

claims.source_statement: The Cayley-Dickson sequence supplies progressively higher-dimensional algebraic foundations.
claims.canonical_statement: The real normed division algebras stop at the octonions. Further Cayley-Dickson doublings remain algebras but lose division, composition, and additional identities.
claims.falsification_test: Construct a nonzero zero divisor in each claimed division algebra beyond dimension eight, or prove the asserted norm composition identity for all elements.
claims.integration_action: Use dimensions 1, 2, 4, and 8 for division-algebra claims; require explicit weaker identities at every higher doubling.

claims.source_statement: Sedenion zero divisors and higher Cayley-Dickson algebras represent physical defects, states, or force structures.
claims.canonical_statement: Higher Cayley-Dickson algebras provide testable algebraic objects, but no retained derivation maps their zero divisors to a measured physical observable.
claims.falsification_test: Define a dimensional state map, derive an observable that changes under zero-divisor structure, and distinguish it from a matched algebra-free control.
claims.integration_action: Keep the algebraic construction in the core and move physical interpretations to the open-hypothesis register.

claims.source_statement: E6 is the automorphism group of J3(O), and E7 is the automorphism group of J3(S).
claims.canonical_statement: For the Albert algebra J3(O), F4 is the automorphism group; suitable real or complex forms of E6 and E7 arise as structure and conformal groups. J3(S) is not an Albert algebra and cannot justify the stated E7 automorphism claim.
claims.falsification_test: Verify each proposed group action preserves the relevant Jordan product or determinant and identify the exact group functor and real form.
claims.integration_action: Replace the source ladder with an automorphism-structure-conformal table and remove J3(S).

claims.source_statement: Spin(8) triality permutes vector and two spinor representations.
claims.canonical_statement: The outer automorphism group of Spin(8) permutes its vector and two inequivalent eight-dimensional spinor representations.
claims.falsification_test: Construct the D4 Dynkin-diagram automorphisms and verify the induced permutation of the three representations.
claims.integration_action: Retain as a mathematical foundation; do not extend triality to fractal or fluid systems without a defined representation.

claims.source_statement: E9, E10, and E11 are exceptional Lie algebras.
claims.canonical_statement: E9 is the affine extension of E8, E10 is hyperbolic, and E11 is very extended; they are infinite-dimensional Kac-Moody algebras rather than additional finite-dimensional exceptional simple Lie algebras.
claims.falsification_test: Derive the generalized Cartan matrices and classify them by affine, hyperbolic, and very-extended criteria.
claims.integration_action: Normalize terminology throughout the framework and isolate proposed supergravity correspondences as conjectural.

claims.source_statement: E10 and E11 supply a general unifying physical symmetry.
claims.canonical_statement: Specific truncated correspondences between E10 or E11 structures and supergravity variables motivate research programs; they do not establish a complete unifying symmetry of observed interactions.
claims.falsification_test: State the level truncation, dictionary, equations matched, and first unmatched term; reject any scope broader than the demonstrated correspondence.
claims.integration_action: Present the established algebra first and the supergravity dictionary as a bounded conjectural application.

claims.source_statement: Monster Group modular invariants enforce stability in fractal and physical kernels.
claims.canonical_statement: Monstrous moonshine relates specific modular functions to graded Monster representations. No retained operator maps that theorem to stability of a fractal, fluid, or physical evolution equation.
claims.falsification_test: Define the Monster representation, modular object, state space, evolution operator, and a stability bound that fails under a matched non-moonshine control.
claims.integration_action: Retain moonshine as mathematics and remove generic stability language from the scientific core.

claims.source_statement: Fractional and negative dimensions behave as dynamical spatial dimensions.
claims.canonical_statement: Hausdorff, box-counting, and generalized dimensions may be non-integer. Negative values arise in specialized multifractal or formal extensions and are not literal negative spatial axes.
claims.falsification_test: Name the measure, metric, limiting procedure, estimator, and admissible domain; verify exact controls and resolution convergence.
claims.integration_action: Use named dimension definitions only and exclude literal negative-space interpretations.

claims.source_statement: Retained fractal dimensions establish scale-invariant structure.
claims.canonical_statement: The retained values are finite-resolution diagnostics because estimator agreement and scale-window refinement have not converged.
claims.falsification_test: Recover exact dimensions for controls, report slope stability across scale windows, and demonstrate convergence under resolution refinement.
claims.integration_action: Report estimator, scale range, uncertainty, and finite-resolution status with every value.

claims.source_statement: A sourced scalar wave equation stabilizes curvature and supplies the missing Superforce mechanism.
claims.canonical_statement: Scalar fields can couple to gravity in specified actions, but the retained equation does not define units, coupling to the metric, stress-energy, boundary data, or a stability theorem.
claims.falsification_test: Provide a covariant action, derive field and metric equations, establish dimensional consistency, and test perturbative stability around a named background.
claims.integration_action: Replace the generic equation with an explicit model or retain it only as an open hypothesis template.

claims.source_statement: Zero-point energy supplies a self-sustaining energy source that mitigates dissipation.
claims.canonical_statement: Casimir and dynamical-Casimir phenomena do not establish cyclic net work extraction from the vacuum; any driven implementation must include work supplied by boundaries, pumps, or control fields.
claims.falsification_test: Close the full energy balance over a cycle, include control work and losses, and reproduce positive net output against blinded matched controls.
claims.integration_action: Replace energy-source language with vacuum-response and driven-conversion terminology.

claims.source_statement: Time crystals amplify ZPE and provide self-sustaining coherence for spacetime engineering.
claims.canonical_statement: Equilibrium continuous time crystals are ruled out under broad conditions; realized discrete time crystals are nonequilibrium many-body phases whose drive, dissipation, and stabilization cannot be omitted from the energy budget.
claims.falsification_test: Specify the driven Hamiltonian or open-system generator, measure subharmonic order and lifetime, and close the pump-to-output energy balance.
claims.integration_action: Retain time-crystalline order as a real nonequilibrium phenomenon and remove free-amplification claims.

claims.source_statement: The Planck-force identity demonstrates unification of fundamental interactions.
claims.canonical_statement: The quantity c^4/G defines a force scale. Algebraic cancellation of hbar does not provide field content, a common gauge structure, coupling relations, or a distinguishing prediction.
claims.falsification_test: Derive a common action and interaction content whose low-energy limits reproduce measured couplings and yield a preregistered distinguishing observable.
claims.integration_action: Retain the dimensional scale and remove claims that the identity is a unification mechanism.

claims.source_statement: A fold-merge or origami operator produces physical dimensional transitions.
claims.canonical_statement: The retained fold-merge expressions do not specify a domain, codomain, topology, measure, operator properties, or physical state map.
claims.falsification_test: Define the operator on a named function or state space, prove closure and continuity properties, and identify an observable that distinguishes folding from a coordinate transformation.
claims.integration_action: Keep as an analogy appendix until a mathematical definition exists.

claims.source_statement: E7 roots carry nontrivial P/Q charge labels that can filter fluid modes.
claims.canonical_statement: Every root lies in the root lattice Q and therefore represents the zero coset in P/Q. The separately defined external Fourier-mode homomorphism does not assign nonzero quotient classes to roots.
claims.falsification_test: Enumerate all roots and compute their P/Q classes; separately define and test any proposed external mode homomorphism.
claims.integration_action: Remove root-as-charge filtering and keep the external Fourier-lattice audit as a separate falsified mechanism.

claims.source_statement: A revised conjecture asks whether Fourier modes can be mapped externally to nontrivial P/Q classes without assigning those classes to roots.
claims.canonical_statement: For E7, P/Q is isomorphic to Z/2 and the unique nontrivial square-symmetry-invariant homomorphism is h(kx,ky)=(kx+ky) mod 2. It rejects no exact convolution triad because homomorphism additivity maps k+p+q=0 to zero charge.
claims.falsification_test: Define the Fourier lattice and quotient target, prove the map is nontrivial and symmetry-compatible, enumerate admitted triads, and reject the mechanism if it performs no better than label-shuffled controls.
claims.integration_action: Retain the map-existence proof and reject homomorphic quotient charge as a nontrivial exact-triad filter.

claims.source_statement: Affine or imaginary-root structure transfers directly to fluid dynamics and evanescent spatial modes.
claims.canonical_statement: The retained code defines neither a current algebra and Sugawara stress tensor nor a dimensional map between the Kac-Moody bilinear form and a fluid dispersion relation.
claims.falsification_test: Define currents, representation level, stress tensor, Ward identities, fluid variables, and a dispersion relation that survives a label-shuffled control.
claims.integration_action: Keep algebraic and fluid models separate until an explicit transfer map passes tests.

claims.source_statement: The retained simulation implements beta-plane dynamics and produces four zonal jets.
claims.canonical_statement: The retained evolution does not contain a beta term, and the final high-resolution state is nearly isotropic under fixed diagnostics; a peak index alone does not establish four strong jets.
claims.falsification_test: Trace beta into the evolution equation and measure zonal energy fraction, jet count, anisotropy, and uncertainty against matched controls.
claims.integration_action: Remove beta-plane and four-jet conclusions from the core; retain the run as a nearly isotropic LBM artifact.

claims.source_statement: A revised hypothesis asks whether an explicitly implemented algebraic filter changes beta-plane jet statistics under matched controls.
claims.canonical_statement: A preregistered barotropic beta-plane solver shows beta-dependent evolution across every seed and refinement. The E7 P/Q homomorphic filter is bit-identical to the identity control because it rejects no exact triads, so the proposed algebraic dynamical effect is falsified.
claims.falsification_test: Preregister zonal energy fraction, jet count threshold, anisotropy, enstrophy flux, conservation error, refinement behavior, and multi-seed effect sizes; reject the filter if it does not exceed matched controls.
claims.integration_action: Retain the beta-plane solver and negative-control result; reject homomorphic quotient filtering as a jet mechanism and do not infer jets from the short decaying runs.

claims.source_statement: The historical CPU D2Q9 demonstration conserves mass.
claims.canonical_statement: The historical equilibrium double-counted sound-speed factors. The corrected implementation now satisfies the population-sum identity and conservation regression tests.
claims.falsification_test: Evaluate equilibrium at nonzero velocity and assert that populations sum to density; fail on injected mass drift.
claims.integration_action: Use the corrected solver only as a numerical prerequisite, not as evidence for exceptional-algebra physics.

claims.source_statement: Tourmaline or related materials support novel scalar-ZPE or excess-energy effects.
claims.canonical_statement: The corpus contains conventional electrical, thermal, and lattice-vibration evidence, but no calibrated raw data, full energy balance, blinded control, or independent replication of a novel coupling.
claims.falsification_test: Measure preregistered output with calibrated instruments, complete energy accounting, matched materials, blinding, and independent replication.
claims.integration_action: Retain conventional material properties and quarantine novel-energy claims as untested.

claims.source_statement: Gravitoelectromagnetism directly couples gravitational and electromagnetic waves and enables dual-field propulsion.
claims.canonical_statement: Gravitoelectromagnetism describes gravitoelectric and gravitomagnetic fields in weak-field or accelerated-frame formulations of general relativity. The electromagnetic analogy does not create a new electromagnetic-gravitational interaction or establish propulsion.
claims.falsification_test: Derive the proposed force from a covariant action, state source and test-body variables with consistent units, recover the general-relativistic weak-field limit, and predict a controlled signal not explained by ordinary electromagnetic coupling or vibration.
claims.integration_action: Retain GEM as a weak-field general-relativity formalism and remove direct-unification and propulsion conclusions.

claims.source_statement: Consciousness emerges from Superforce, plasmoid, binaural, or aetheric resonance.
claims.canonical_statement: The retained texts define neither a measurable consciousness variable nor a causal mechanism, dose, control, or discriminating prediction.
claims.falsification_test: Define the intervention, biological endpoint, causal model, blinding, preregistered effect size, and null result that rejects the hypothesis.
claims.integration_action: Exclude from the mathematical-physics core and preserve only as historical ideation.
